title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: Hold: the consumption-monitoring row incorrectly reports that no automation surface is documented. Microsoft documents an environment resource consumption API, although it is deprecated; the allocation API, maker paths, licensing qualifications and roadmap details otherwise check out.

claims.claim: An agent node invokes an AI agent as a step within a Copilot Studio workflow.
claims.quote: The agent node lets a flow hand a step over to an AI agent that can reason, call tools, and pull from knowledge sources before returning a result.
